prompts.bull: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet for an illustrated side-scrolling sanctuary action game. Reference 1 is old identity ONLY: rebuild the Minotaur with sophisticated smooth painted illustration and natural materials. Reference 2 is approved target rendering style: mossy blue-green stone/steel, rich natural texture, ivory edge light and warm amber. EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 separated full-body sprites, each entirely inside its equal cell with 30px clear gap. Transparent background, no text, no grid. Same right-facing three-quarter side view, same scale, same identity every frame. A powerful bull-headed Minotaur, brown fur, ivory curved horns, amber eyes, dark blue-green worn steel armor with aged bronze details, burgundy fabric, massive shoulder-mounted six-barrel rotary gatling gun aimed right and brass ammunition belt; axe stowed except row 2. No halos, circular shields, blue outlines, pixels, tiny pixel-art clusters, or ground shadows. Painterly sharp high-resolution details. Row 1: FOUR genuinely different running/charging strides: left foot planted forward right tucked, compression both knees, right foot planted forward left tucked, airborne stretched stride. Torso leans forward, shoulders twist, horns point forward, cloth and belt swing, feet clearly articulate. Row 2: axe attack FOUR sequential poses: backward crouched windup, tall overhead anticipation, explosive forward downward chop with axe contacting ground on right, low follow-through recoil. Row 3: FOUR shoulder gun firing poses: steady ready, barrel rotated one eighth turn with shoulder recoil, opposite leg braced with shoulder recovery, barrel rotating recoil; NO drawn muzzle flashes or bullets (runtime supplies them). Row 4: idle alert, hit recoil leaning backward, collapsing kneeling, defeated prone. Keep the gun visible rightward and consistent in every pose. Entire body anatomy must move between frames, do not translate the same pose. Canvas 2048x2048 if possible.
prompts.dragon: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent animation sheet for illustrated sanctuary platform game. Image 1 identity reference old armored cannon dragon; image 2 approved painterly style. Rebuild same creature with rich smooth natural illustration, detailed blue-green obsidian steel scales, aged bronze shoulder cannons, burgundy leathery wings, ivory horns, amber throat, absolutely no pixel clusters. EXACT 4 columns x 3 rows = 12 full-body frames with very generous transparent gutters. Each individual dragon wholly within equal cell and same size. All face RIGHT in side profile, wings are entirely visible. Two forward-pointing bronze cannons attached along upper shoulders, muzzle ends clearly visible. No background, text, grid, shields, aura, fire particles or muzzle flashes. ROW 1 FOUR sequential full-body flight poses: 1 wings tall overhead neck stretched legs tucked tail curls down; 2 powerful downstroke wings diagonal forward chest compressing neck lowered legs curling back tail extended; 3 wings all way down below torso, chest lifted hips pivot, tail counter-bent up; 4 recovery wings folded upward shoulder sockets elevated neck stretched legs extended. Torso, neck, shoulder girdle, hips, feet and tail ALL animate so it is a swimming whole-body flight cycle, not pasted wings. ROW 2 FOUR sequential cannon/breath attack poses: 1 wings wide, neck coils and cannons aim forward; 2 cannons recoil backward shoulders hunch and mouth opens; 3 mouth fully open roar neck extends, rear feet kick and tail lashes; 4 body regains balance wings raise, cannons return. ROW 3: flight-ready neutral, hit recoil curling upward, falling limp in air with folded wings, defeated prone on belly. Preserve same dragon identity/materials/proportions every cell. Natural fine rendering not 8bit, no blue aura. Transparent true alpha. Aim for 2048x1536.
prompts.environment: Use case: stylized-concept. Four high-resolution detailed painted environment game assets on a TRUE transparent background. Match the attached approved moonlit Lantern sanctuary EXACTLY: blue-green old stone, natural moss and roots, warm amber lanterns, ivory highlights, fine detailed illustration, NO PIXEL ART and no palette limiting. 2 columns x 2 rows, four fully separate objects, generous gutters, do not touch or overlap. TOP LEFT: a broad horizontal mossy stone floating platform, flat walkable top, width about twice height, front-facing platformer camera, irregular stone underside dangling roots. TOP RIGHT: ruined pointed stone arch with weathered carved blocks and ivy, standalone full arch. BOTTOM LEFT: hanging tall antique bronze lantern on short chain emitting subtle warm amber light, isolated silhouette. BOTTOM RIGHT: giant gnarled tree-root column wrapping old stone, wide base roots, one small amber lantern nestling in roots. These are full-size production props cut out for a side scrolling game, not tiny icons. No scenery, ground plane, captions, borders, shadows outside objects, blue glow or shield shapes. Keep silhouettes complete. 2048 square.
